bioconda.name: panisoguard
bioconda.summary: Caller-agnostic adjudication of long-read RNA-seq novel isoforms
bioconda.description:
PanIsoGuard ingests novel isoform calls from long-read RNA-seq callers
(FLAIR/IsoQuant/Bambu/...) and/or SQANTI3 output, plus a BAM and optional
short-read SJ.tab and personalized haplotype FASTAs, and re-classifies each
novel call into a confidence class with a mechanistic attribution and a
provenance/circularity flag. Depends only on htslib.
